title: Welcome & System Overview
description: Landing screen introducing Ask Dreeso Memory — the enterprise knowledge and memory assistant. Displays the system logo, tagline, and a brief overview of capabilities before prompting the user to begin.

title: Persona Selection
description: User selects one of four personas to explore the system from their perspective. Each persona card shows name, role, avatar initials, and a brief description of their focus areas.

title: Lukas — Project Director Dashboard
description: Lukas Müller's personalized dashboard showing strategic oversight clusters, key portfolio metrics, and quick-access intelligence cards tailored to the Project Director role.

title: Lukas — Strategic Query & Response
description: Lukas asks about the current status and strategic alignment of all active projects. The system responds with a rich data table, charts, and source system attribution.

title: Lukas — Cross-Domain Action & Propagation
description: Lukas triggers an action such as escalating a risk. The system displays the confirmation dialog, cross-domain effects across connected systems, and the propagation chain with latency and confidence indicators.

title: Elena — Senior Quantity Surveyor Dashboard
description: Elena Rossi's personalized dashboard showing cost analysis clusters, procurement intelligence, and valuation tracking cards tailored to the Senior Quantity Surveyor role.

title: Elena — Cost Analysis Query & Response
description: Elena queries the detailed cost breakdown and variance analysis for active projects. The system responds with cost tables, variance charts, and drill-down CTA bubbles.

title: Elena — Follow-Up Query & Procurement
description: Elena follows up with a procurement-focused query about supplier performance and outstanding claims. Demonstrates the conversational memory and context continuity of the system.

title: Elena — Budget Update Action & Propagation
description: Elena triggers a budget update action. The system shows the confirmation dialog, affected systems including SAP FI, SAP MM, and Primavera P6, and the full propagation chain.

title: Sophie — Project Manager Dashboard
description: Sophie Dubois's personalized dashboard showing schedule management clusters, resource allocation, and progress tracking cards tailored to the Project Manager role.

title: Sophie — Schedule & Milestone Query
description: Sophie queries the critical path and upcoming milestones for her projects. The system responds with milestone tables, status distributions, and at-risk indicators.

title: Sophie — Resource Conflict Resolution
description: Sophie reviews resource allocation conflicts across her project teams. The system highlights double-bookings, suggests resolutions, and shows team utilization metrics.

title: Sophie — Task Reassignment & Propagation
description: Sophie triggers a task reassignment action. The system displays the propagation chain across Primavera P6, Workday, and Procore with real-time update indicators.

title: James — Sales Director Dashboard
description: James Carter's personalized dashboard showing sales pipeline clusters, client insights, and market intelligence cards tailored to the Sales Director role.

title: James — Pipeline & Client Health Query
description: James queries the current sales pipeline and client health scores. The system responds with pipeline stage breakdowns, trend charts, and engagement indicators.

title: James — Market Intelligence & Competitors
description: James explores market trends and competitor activity. The system presents sector growth forecasts, competitor moves, and upcoming tender opportunities.

title: James — Proposal Submission & Propagation
description: James triggers a proposal submission action. The system shows the confirmation dialog, cross-domain effects on Salesforce, SAP FI, and Workday, and the propagation chain.

title: Cross-Domain System Map
description: A visual overview of all connected enterprise systems showing data flow relationships, propagation paths, and real-time synchronization status across the entire platform.

title: Memory & Context Showcase
description: Demonstrates the system's memory capabilities — how context is preserved across queries, how persona-specific insights are retained, and how cross-session intelligence builds over time.

title: Closing & Call to Action
description: Final screen summarizing the key capabilities demonstrated throughout the prototype. Includes a call to action for next steps, contact information, and links to explore further.
